SELECT o.status,
       COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS n_orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01' THEN o.web_order_id END) AS hel_dec1_orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01' THEN o.web_order_id END) AS utc_dec1_orders
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
   OR CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH day_orders AS (
    SELECT o.*
    FROM fact_web_order o
    WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
),
test_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.receipt_id
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    WHERE p.category = 'ZZ Test' OR s.store_id = 999
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS all_orders,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'cancelled') AS not_cancelled,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND web_order_id IN (SELECT receipt_id FROM test_orders)) AS test_not_cancelled,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND web_order_id NOT IN (SELECT receipt_id FROM test_orders)) AS real_not_cancelled,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'processing') AS processing,
       COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS distinct_ids,
       MIN(order_ts_utc) AS min_ts, MAX(order_ts_utc) AS max_ts
FROM day_orders
